text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kris S and Gimlet are finally clashing for the first time in the Senior tier...!!
What kind of race is this going to be?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, Gimlet~~!
Please just finish the race safe and sound...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...I swear I'll find it...! My... my own answer...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ââWe've finally come this far.
choice_data_list: That went by in a flash, huh.
That went by in a flash, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is fine.
Living is nothing more than a series of fleeting moments.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't wasted a single moment
of your life leading up to this day.
You have continued to shine brilliantly in every fleeting instant."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because of that that you feel this way.
...You should take pride in it."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...After I finish running this 'Takarazuka Kinen'—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We have new tasks ahead.
Continue to stand by my side.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Why so surprised?
You were the one who said you wanted to "get even more intoxicated by me."

Hearing Tanino Gimlet say that
made me uncontrollably happy... and I was powerless
to stop those feelings from overflowing.
choice_data_list: It's still too early for Gimlet, huh?
It's still a little too early for Gimlet, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's a pleasant way to get tipsy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Now, look up and marvel to your heart's content!
Behold my glorious descent!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Gimlet!! Lady Gimlet!!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ......Neo Universe will ask a "question".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You are—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Someone with a completely different perspective...!
Standing on the same ground, yet entranced by—or devoted to—
something even more deeply than I am—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Tanino Gimlet and
Neo Universe are standing side by side...!
Isn't this an incredible photo op?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Universe-senpai came from the Japanese Derby to the Takarazuka Kinen,
and she and Gim-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Two Umamusume who kicked common sense to the curb, huh—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—It really is far away, isn't it?
That's all the more reason for me to...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Tanino Gimlet is "entropy." She aims to "destroy."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""PREV"... already "collapsed".
Even so, will you
"SIPT"... continue to "change" without fear?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I am the harbinger of destruction and rebirth—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have no fear left of this world changing now.
I have long since rebelled against destiny, with a brand-new script in hand!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Then... we'll need to "observe" it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Use those magical eyes that reflect the cosmos
and see everything for yourself to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't it feel like
they're saying super cool things to each other~...?
I don't really get it, but they sure make a picture.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it, I just don't belong here—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"—No, no.
I decided I was going to do my best today.
Don't think about it, don't think about it...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is just okonomiyaki toppings...
Okonomiyaki toppings...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Every single one of them holds a truly unique soul, and they are preparing to face me...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And among all of that,
what truly captivates me is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kris S. It's you...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is pure ecstasy!
That your name is listed at the very end of my second scenario!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Test my "strength" with that boundless
"strength" of yours!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—With unchanged, utmost devotion...
—I shall overthrow you.
